full_prompt_en: A square editorial watercolor cartoon places a large suited man and a much smaller seated figure in an otherwise white, nearly empty space. The older man occupies the left half, bending deeply at the knees and waist so his head approaches the level of the person opposite him. His pale yellow hair and lowered face are drawn with quick dark strokes, and a black overcoat spreads into a broad triangular mass from shoulders to the ground. One hand extends downward near his bent knee, while polished dark shoes touch the faint gray floor line. On the right, the smaller person wears a pale blue-gray coat, cropped trousers, dark shoes, and a small knit cap. The figure sits low with knees bent and head tilted up toward the larger man, creating an immediate exchange through posture rather than a detailed setting. A narrow warm orange strip peeks from beneath the big coat and trails along the ground at the far left. Light gray washes and a few beige marks make contact shadows beneath the feet and seated body, but most of the surrounding paper remains untouched white. The linework is loose, slightly scratchy, and concentrated around faces, hands, clothing edges, and shoes. Thin watercolor layers give the coat and cap uneven tones without filling every contour. Even studio-like light is implied by the bright paper and modest contact shadows; there is no dramatic directional shadow. The large difference in scale carries the image's visual tension, while the restrained color keeps attention on the confrontation. The overall composition is sparse and satirical, balancing a heavy dark wedge against a small pale form across broad negative space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形编辑式水彩漫画把一名高大的西装男子和一名身形小得多的坐者置于几乎空白的白色空间。年长男子占据左半幅，膝与腰深深弯下，使头接近对方的高度。浅黄头发和低垂面孔由快速深色笔痕描出，黑色大衣从肩到地面展开成宽大三角形色团。一只手垂向弯曲膝旁，擦亮的深色鞋落在淡灰色地面线上。右侧较小的人穿浅蓝灰外套、短裤、深鞋与小针织帽。其低坐、双膝弯曲、头抬向大个子男子，两人的交流主要由姿态而非细致环境传达。一条狭窄暖橙色带从大衣下露出，沿最左侧地面拖曳。浅灰薄涂和少量米色痕迹在脚与坐姿身体下构成接触阴影，但周围纸面大部分仍保持未着色的白。线条松散、略带刮擦感，集中在面孔、手、衣缘和鞋上。薄水彩层使大衣与帽子出现不均匀色调，却没有填满每条轮廓。明亮纸面与克制接触阴影暗示均匀的影棚式光线，没有戏剧性定向影。巨大的尺度差承载画面张力，克制色彩让注意集中在对峙上。整体构图稀疏而带讽刺意味，以沉重暗色楔形对照小而浅的形体，两者之间留有宽阔负空间。
style_prompt_en: Editorial watercolor cartooning leaves much of the paper white, placing loose ink contours and thin uneven washes only where they carry the idea. Broad charcoal masses contrast with small pale gray and muted warm accents. Scratchy fine lines sharpen expressive details, while soft watercolor edges and faint contact shadows keep the figures light on the page. Scale contrast and generous negative space do more work than background decoration. Light reads as clear and even, with the paper itself providing the brightest value. The overall treatment is economical, pointed, and gently satirical.
style_prompt_zh: 编辑式水彩漫画让大部分纸面保持白色，只在有助表达之处放置松散墨线与不均匀薄涂。宽阔炭色团块对照小块浅灰和柔和暖色强调。细碎刮擦线锐化有表现力的细节，柔和水彩边缘与淡接触影使形体轻落纸面。尺度反差和宽裕负空间比背景装饰承担更多作用。光线清澈均匀，纸本身提供最亮明度。整体简练、鲜明且温和讽刺。
theme_en: A large suited man crouching to address a much smaller seated figure
theme_zh: 一位体形夸张的西装男子蹲下，与小个子坐者说话
name: Barry Blitt
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
